Price section and launch copy must not be treated as current stock confirmation.

CP 4 BHK price refers to 2,532 sq ft and cannot be assigned automatically to the developer 2,460 sq ft plan.
Seven buildings and 144 homes are the selected portal schedule; other portal text says 250 units and 3.2/3.5 acres. Land reference 13,460 sq m is approximately 3.33 acres.

Brochure is image-only. OCR/visual plan confirmation is required before treating every portal variant as the complete sanctioned schedule.
Developer microsite prices of 35/40 lakh are undated legacy prices. They are not current quotes; do not publish them as live starting prices.
Jasper and Iridium are sometimes merged in portal records. Do not silently import Iridium layouts into Jasper.

Same developer page displays sold out, INR 1.09 crore in Price, and INR 1.30 crore for 2,550+ sq ft garden plots. Keep these as separate references; no safe full-range calculation is possible from this page.
Master layout is the relevant plan for land; do not fabricate an apartment-style floor plan or rectangular dimensions for irregular plots.

The master area is 25 acres. CP unit totals of 326 and older site totals of 329 are not independently reconciled.
Developer plans are 1,250, 1,526 and 1,745 sq ft SBUA; portal 1,230/1,720 figures must not override them.
The site labels a combined measure RERA + Balcony. Store this as a combined measure, never as pure carpet.

Developer page now describes 2, 3 and 4 BHK, with maximum 2,120 sq ft; CP has an older 2,110 sq ft 4 BHK. Use the plan-specific area.
Retain existing route epitome-i while customer-facing project name follows Sumadhura Epitome.

Use the dedicated project brochure and booking site. Corporate project page includes unrelated Palazzo plans and amenities; excluded.
Dedicated FAQ says 720 homes, other marketing records differ; retain source scope, verify registered current total.
CP 2030 possession conflicts with secondary RERA completion December 2032. Do not replace the latter with an optimistic launch date.
Alpine/Blossom shown first; Cascade/Dewdrop are marked coming soon on the residences page.
Developer 1.5 BHK starts 93.5 lakh and 2 BHK starts 1.39 crore. These override older CP starting figures for those types.
50,000 sq ft is facilities area, not necessarily enclosed clubhouse area or amenity count.
CP 3 BHK 1,380 sq ft price 2.73 crore is anomalous relative to the rest of its table and is held for confirmation.

CP studio and 2 BHK are marked sold out; original plan existence is not proof of current availability.
Primary Homeplans PDF is used for exact saleable and carpet areas.

Phase 2 CP prices apply to the table’s own sizes. Do not apply its 1,317 sq ft quote to a 1,354 sq ft developer plan.

Studio 501 sq ft is a documented format but has no current priced CP row in the selected source.
Developer plans use 468–2,684 sq ft; CP price table uses 506–2,190 sq ft. Store CP quoted layouts separately; do not attach their prices to mismatching primary plans.
13.5-acre CP master figure, older 15-acre catalogue figure and RERA phase boundary need reconciliation.
Certificate validity in September 2031 is not a contractual possession promise.

CP Phase 1 prices are for carpet areas. Existing 2,340/2,952/5,904/7,800 sq ft records need approved phase-specific plans before use.
